```objc - (UICollectionViewCell *)collectionView:(UICollectionView *)collectionView cellForItemAtIndexPath:(NSIndexPath *)indexPath { UICollectionViewCell *cell = [collectionView dequeueReusableCellWithReuseIdentifier:self.cellIdentifier forIndexPath:indexPath]; NSAssert([cell isKindOfClass:[ItemCell class]], @"Unexpected type for cell. Check configuration.\n"); Item *item = self.items[indexPath.row]; ItemCell *itemCell = (ItemCell *)cell; itemCell.nameLabel.text = item.name; UIImage *thumbnail = [item.image imageByPreparingThumbnailOfSize:self.thumbnailSize]; itemCell.thumbnailImageView.image = thumbnail; return cell; } ```
